# GeoAlert

## Role

Founder / Builder

## Positioning

A complete 0→1 product built independently, from product strategy and UX through architecture, engineering, release and distribution.

## Product

Location-based alerts that monitor geofences in the background and notify users at the right time, including when the app is closed.

## Product capabilities

- configurable geographic locations
- multiple alert distances
- vibration and alarm behaviors
- background geofencing
- notifications when the app is closed
- one-time and recurring alerts
- optional social/friend connections
- local-first usage without requiring an account
- optional cloud synchronization
- templates such as home, work and bus
- groups for organizing locations
- alert history

## Technical positioning

- React Native
- Expo
- TypeScript
- native iOS/Android geofencing
- cloud backend
- CI/CD
- mobile-first architecture

## Why it matters for applications

GeoAlert is strong evidence that Rodrigo is still a builder. He can independently take a product from idea to production rather than only managing teams.

Official project site: https://www.geoalert.com.br/
